records.title: Toward a Safe Internet of Agents
records.reason: arXiv abstract: conceptual security and safety framework for interconnected LLM-agent systems; it does not introduce a compute, memory, latency, throughput, cache, or serving optimization.

records.title: Video-R2: Reinforcing Consistent and Grounded Reasoning in Multimodal Language Models
records.reason: arXiv abstract: introduces consistency/visual-grounding measures and reinforcement learning for multimodal video reasoning quality; no inference-cost reduction mechanism is described.

records.title: A novel deep neural model for efficient and scalable historical place image classification
records.reason: Scientific Reports publisher abstract: HistoNet classifies historical-place images using convolutional and transformer components, motivated by heritage image recognition; it is not LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Economies of Open Intelligence: Tracing Power & Participation in the Model Ecosystem
records.reason: The full text analyzes model-hub downloads, developer/national concentration and participation in the open-model ecosystem. It is an empirical political-economy study, not a system or method for LLM inference/serving; the candidate’s linked model-system lineage is only a broad topic association.

records.title: COLLAR: combating low-rank temporal latent representation for high-dimensional multivariate time series prediction using dynamic Koopman regularization
records.reason: Springer Nature publisher abstract and Introduction: COLLAR is a low-rank autoencoder/GRU/Koopman model for multivariate time-series forecasting; its gains target prediction accuracy/robustness, not LLM runtime.
